why: No placeholder fills (Microsoft Outlook2's recipient user@example.com stays as written; the MySQL, Gemini and Outlook credentials are the bench's dummies). See timeCompression.

timeCompression.why: Wait (v1.1, unit minutes, amount left at its default of 1) waits a minute after each cost center's email before the loop moves on. It is shortened to 1 second on both sides. This changes when the run resumes, not what it does: the wait comes after the only write, the loop's next turn reads nothing that depends on elapsed time, and no expression reads the time after it. Not a placeholder fill, so results flag it as time compression (config.nonPlaceholder).
